question: If a man takes 36 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 5 km/h, then the distance covered by him is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 km**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **3 km** is the distance covered by the man.
 
• To find the distance, we use the formula: **Distance = Speed × Time.**
 
• Given the speed is **5 km/h** and the time taken is **36 minutes**.
 
• First, convert the time from minutes to hours: **36 minutes = 36/60 hours = 0.6 hours.**
 
• Then, calculate the distance: **Distance = 5 km/h × 0.6 hours = 3 km.**
